
```{r}
all_data_clean |>
  count(participant_id) |>
  DT::datatable(rownames = F)
```

Look at number of replications per treatment

```{r}
all_data_clean |> 
  count(cpLoc, sigma, theta) |> 
  complete(cpLoc, sigma, theta) |> 
  arrange(-n) |> 
  DT::datatable()
```

Look at number of participants per version x treatment

```{r}
all_data_clean |> 
  count(version, cpLoc, sigma, theta) |> 
  complete(version, cpLoc, sigma, theta) |> 
  arrange(-n) |> 
  mutate(n = replace_na(n, 0)) |> 
  DT::datatable()
```

Plot of all of that...

```{r}
all_data_clean |>
  count(version, cpLoc, sigma, theta) |> 
  complete(version, cpLoc, sigma, theta) |> 
  arrange(-n) |> 
  mutate(n = replace_na(n, 0)) |> 
  filter(theta != "0") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = theta, 
             y = n, 
             fill = version)
         ) +
  geom_bar(stat     = "identity", 
           position = "stack") +
  facet_grid(sigma ~ cpLoc, 
             labeller = label_both) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Theta \n(Mean Shift + Direction)",
       y = "",
       title = "Number of Participants who evaluated the lineup",
       subtitle = str_c("By ", "<span style = 'color:#1B9E77'>**version A**</span>", " and ", 
       "<span style = 'color:#D95F02'>**version B**</span>")
       ) + 
  theme(plot.subtitle = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 12),
        legend.position = "none"
        )
```

## Binomial GLMM

| Source of Variation                               | Degrees of Freedom (2520 - 1) = 2519 |
|---------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------|
| participant_id                                    | (210 - 1) = 209                      |
| theta                                             | (3 - 1) = 5                          |
| direction                                         | (2 - 1) = 1                          |
| cpLoc                                             | (3 - 1) = 2                          |
| sigma                                             | (2 - 1) = 1                          |
| theta x direction                                 | (3 - 1)(2 - 1) = 2                   |
| theta x cpLoc                                     | (3 - 1)(3 - 1) = 4                   |
| theta x sigma                                     | (3 - 1)(2 - 1) = 2                   |
| direction x cpLoc                                 | (3 - 1)(3 - 1) = 4                   |
| directionigma                                     | (3 - 1)(2 - 1) = 2                   |
| cpLoc x sigma                                     | (3 - 1)(2 - 1) = 2                   |
| theta x cpLoc x sigma                             | (6 - 1)(3 - 1)(2 - 1) = 10           |
| participant_id x theta x cpLoc x sigma - residual | ... = 2275 ???                       |
|                                                   |                                      |

```{r}
#| eval: true
#| warning: false
library(lme4)
library(emmeans)

# mod_glm <- glm(correct ~ direction*theta*sigma*cpLoc + participant_id,
#              family = binomial(),
#              data = all_data_clean
#              )
# aov(mod_glm) |>
#   summary()

mod <- glmer(correct ~ direction*theta_abs*sigma*cpLoc + (1 | participant_id),
             family = binomial(),
             control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl   = list(maxfun = 20000)
             ),
             data = all_data_clean
             )
```

```{r}
# summary(mod)
car::Anova(mod)
anova(mod)
# sum(mod)
```

# RESULTS 1: PROBABILITY OF DETECTION

```{r}
estimates <- emmeans(mod, ~ direction:theta_abs:sigma:cpLoc, type = "response", infer = c(T,T))

estimates |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  mutate(cpLoc = case_when(cpLoc == "0.333333333" ~ 0.33,
                           cpLoc == "0.5" ~ 0.50,
                           cpLoc == "0.666666667" ~ 0.66)
         ) |> 
  DT::datatable()
```

### 4-way Probs -- Change Point and Direction for each theta abs and sigma

```{r}
emmeans(mod, ~ sigma:theta_abs:direction:cpLoc, type = "response", infer = c(T,T)) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(cpLoc = fct_recode(cpLoc,
                            "Early" = "0.333333333",
                            "Middle" = "0.5",
                            "Late" = "0.666666667"
                            ),
         theta_abs = fct_relevel(theta_abs, 
                                 c("5", "3", "1")
                                 ),
         direction = fct_relevel(direction, 
                                 c("Negative", "Positive")
                                 )
         ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = sigma, 
             color = direction,
             shape = direction
             )
         ) +
  geom_point(aes(y = prob), 
             position = position_dodge(0.6),
             size=3
             ) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = asymp.LCL, 
                    ymax = asymp.UCL
                    ), 
                width = 0, 
                position = position_dodge(0.6)
                ) +
  facet_grid(theta_abs ~ cpLoc,
             labeller = label_both
             ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 0.6) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(y = "",
       x = "",
       subtitle = "Noise",
       title = "Probability of Correctly Identifying the Target Panel",
       color = "Direction",
       shape = "Direction") +
  guides(shape = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE),
         color = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE))
```

### Probability of Magnitude (high baseline) for Noise Level and Direction (averaged over cpLoc)

```{r}
emmeans(mod, ~ theta_abs:sigma:direction:cpLoc, type = "response") |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(direction = fct_relevel(direction, ref = "Negative")) |> 
  ggplot(aes(y = theta_abs, 
             color = direction,
             shape = direction
             )
         ) +
  geom_point(aes(x = prob), 
             position = position_dodge(0.6)
             ) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = asymp.LCL, 
                    xmax = asymp.UCL
                    ), 
                width = 0, 
                position = position_dodge(0.6)
                ) +
  facet_grid(sigma ~ cpLoc, labeller = label_both) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#D95F02", "#1B9E77")) +
  labs(y = "",
       x = "",
       subtitle = "Mean Shift Magnitude",
       title = "Probability of Correctly Identifying the Target Panel",
       color = "Direction",
       shape = "Direction") +
  guides(shape = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE),
         color = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent)
```

# RESULT 2: COMPARE ODDS POSITIVE / ODDS NEGATIVE

### 4-way -- Change Point and Direction for each theta abs and sigma

```{r}
emmeans(mod, ~ direction | theta_abs:cpLoc:sigma, type = "response") |> 
  pairs(infer = c(T,T)) |> 
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(cpLoc = fct_recode(cpLoc,
                            "Early" = "0.333333333",
                            "Middle" = "0.5",
                            "Late" = "0.666666667")
         ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(y = theta_abs, 
             color = cpLoc,
             shape = cpLoc
             )
         ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, 
             color = "darkgray", 
             linetype = "dashed"
             ) +
  geom_point(aes(x = odds.ratio), 
             position = position_dodge(0.6),
             size=3
             ) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = asymp.LCL, 
                    xmax = asymp.UCL
                    ), 
                width = 0, 
                position = position_dodge(0.6)
                ) +
  facet_grid(sigma ~ .,
             labeller = label_both
             ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 0.6) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(y = "",
       x = "",
       subtitle = "Mean Shift Magnitude",
       title = "Odds Ratio of Correctly Identifying the Target Panel \nbetween a Positive and Negative Shift",
       color = "Change Point \nLocation",
       shape = "Change Point \nLocation") +
  guides(shape = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE),
         color = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::comma)
```

# RESULT 4: MAGNITUDE AND DIRECTION (FOR EACH NOISE LEVEL)

### Probability of Magnitude (high baseline) for Noise Level and Direction (averaged over cpLoc)

```{r}
emmeans(mod, ~ theta_abs | sigma:direction, type = "response") |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(direction = fct_relevel(direction, ref = "Negative")) |> 
  ggplot(aes(y = theta_abs, 
             color = direction,
             shape = direction
             )
         ) +
  geom_point(aes(x = prob), 
             position = position_dodge(0.6)
             ) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = asymp.LCL, 
                    xmax = asymp.UCL
                    ), 
                width = 0, 
                position = position_dodge(0.6)
                ) +
  facet_wrap(~ sigma, ncol = 1, labeller = label_both) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#D95F02", "#1B9E77")) +
  labs(y = "",
       x = "",
       subtitle = "Mean Shift Magnitude",
       title = "Probability of Correctly Identifying the Target Panel \n(Averaged over Change Point Location)",
       color = "Direction",
       shape = "Direction") +
  guides(shape = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE),
         color = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent)
```

```{r}
                    xmax = asymp.UCL
                    ), 
                width = 0, 
                position = position_dodge(0.6)
                ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, 
             color = "darkgray", 
             linetype = "dashed"
             ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 0.6) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(y = "",
       x = "",
       subtitle = "Mean Shift Magnitude",
       title = "Odds of Correctly Identifying the Target Panel \nbetween a Positive and Negative Shift \n(Averaged over Location)",
       color = "Noise",
       shape = "Noise") +
  guides(shape = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE),
         color = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::comma)
```

## Sensitivity Analysis against the t-test

```{r}

all_data_clean |> 
  mutate(ttest_decision = as.factor(as.numeric(pvalue<0.05)),
         correct=as.factor(correct)) |> 
  select(theta_abs,direction,cpLoc, sigma, correct,ttest_decision) |> 
  group_by(theta_abs,direction,cpLoc,sigma) |> 
  arrange(theta_abs,direction,cpLoc,sigma) |> 
  rowwise() |> 
  mutate(TP=ifelse(ttest_decision==1 & correct==1,1,0),
         FP = ifelse(ttest_decision==0 & correct==1,1,0),
         TN= ifelse(ttest_decision==0 & correct==0,1,0),
         FN=ifelse(ttest_decision==1 & correct==0,1,0)) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  group_by(theta_abs,direction,cpLoc,sigma) |> 
  summarize(TPtotal=sum(TP),
            FPtotal=sum(FP),
            TNtotal=sum(TN),
            FNtotal=sum(FN)) |> 
  mutate(sensitivity=ifelse(TPtotal+FNtotal!=0,TPtotal/(TPtotal+FNtotal),0),
        specificity=ifelse(TNtotal+FPtotal!=0,TNtotal/(TNtotal+FPtotal),0)
            ) ->sensspec
# write.csv(sensspec,file = "Sensitivity-Specificity Analysis.csv")  

sensspec |> 
      mutate(cpLoc = fct_recode(cpLoc,
                            "Early" = "0.333333333",
                            "Middle" = "0.5",
                            "Late" = "0.666666667"),
             sigma = fct_recode(sigma,
                                "Low Variance"="1",
                                "High Variance"="2"),
             theta_abs = fct_recode(theta_abs,
                                    "Low" = "1",
                                    "Medium" = "3",
                                    "High" = "5"),
             direction = fct_recode(direction,
                                    "(+)"="Positive",
                                    "(-)"="Negative")
         ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(y=sensitivity,x=theta_abs,color=sigma,shape=sigma)) + 
  geom_point(size=3)+
  theme_bw() + 
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(y = "Sensitivity",
       x = "Shift Magnitude",
       color = "Noise",
       shape = "Noise") +
  facet_grid(direction ~ cpLoc,
             labeller = label_both
             )

sensspec |> 
      mutate(cpLoc = fct_recode(cpLoc,
                            "Early" = "0.333333333",
                            "Middle" = "0.5",
                            "Late" = "0.666666667"),
             sigma = fct_recode(sigma,
                                "Low Variance"="1",
                                "High Variance"="2"),
             theta_abs = fct_recode(theta_abs,
                                    "Low" = "1",
                                    "Medium" = "3",
                                    "High" = "5"),
             direction = fct_recode(direction,
                                    "(+)"="Positive",
                                    "(-)"="Negative")
         ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(y=specificity,x=theta_abs,color=sigma,shape=sigma)) + 
  geom_point(size=3)+
  theme_bw() + 
  # theme(aspect.ratio = 0.6) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(y = "Specificity",
       x = "Shift Magnitude",
       color = "Noise",
       shape = "Noise") +
  facet_grid(direction ~ cpLoc,
             labeller = label_both
             )
```
